description: This file implements the GStreamerWebAudioPlayerClient class, which manages audio playback using GStreamer, including opening, closing, playing, pausing, setting end-of-stream, handling new audio samples, and managing backend communication and state notifications.

classes.name: GStreamerWebAudioPlayerClient
classes.description: A class that manages WebAudio playback using GStreamer, handling backend communication, buffer management, and state notifications.

methods.name: notifyPushSamplesCallback
methods.description: Callback function invoked when the push samples timer expires, triggers the pushSamples method.

methods.name: parseGstStructureFormat
methods.description: Parses the format string from GStreamer caps to extract sample size, endianness, sign, and float properties.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Comparison operator for WebAudioPcmConfig to check inequality.

methods.name: GStreamerWebAudioPlayerClient::GStreamerWebAudioPlayerClient
methods.description: Constructor initializing the WebAudio player client with provided callbacks.

methods.name: GStreamerWebAudioPlayerClient::open
methods.description: Initializes the audio backend with provided GstCaps, parsing format and configuring the backend.

methods.name: GStreamerWebAudioPlayerClient::close
methods.description: Closes the backend and cancels timers.

methods.name: GStreamerWebAudioPlayerClient::setEos
methods.description: Sets end-of-stream, pushing remaining samples if any.

methods.name: GStreamerWebAudioPlayerClient::isOpen
methods.description: Returns whether the backend is open.

methods.name: GStreamerWebAudioPlayerClient::notifyPushSamplesTimerExpired
methods.description: Handles timer expiration to push samples.

methods.name: GStreamerWebAudioPlayerClient::notifyNewSample
methods.description: Handles new GstBuffer sample, queues it, and triggers sample push.

methods.name: GStreamerWebAudioPlayerClient::pushSamples
methods.description: Pushes buffered samples to the backend, managing buffer sizes and leftovers.

methods.name: GStreamerWebAudioPlayerClient::isNewConfig
methods.description: Checks if the new configuration differs from current.

methods.name: GStreamerWebAudioPlayerClient::notifyState
methods.description: Notifies external callbacks of state changes or errors.
